premiseReVerification.defectLocation: Confirmed by reading parcel-value-history.mjs's own module comment: WILLIAMSON_HISTORY_CROSSWALK_SQL is explicitly a disjoint copy of parcel-record-fill.mjs's WILLIAMSON_CROSSWALK_SQL (carries tax_year, joins a differently-shaped hoisted table), created disjoint on purpose so the shared job harness (parcel-record-fill.mjs) stayed untouched. This is exactly why S6's fix never traveled here: it isn't a shared-code bug, it's an independently-reimplemented copy of the SAME query shape that only received the R1B uniqueness logic, never the S6 amendment.

fixBuild.approach: Mirrors S6's own fix exactly: a county-wide situs_share_count guard (vh_r_situs), requiring situs_share_count = 1 in the crosswalk's target CTE. Applied S6's own leave_behind performance lesson from the start rather than repeating it: vh_r_situs is hoisted ONCE per county into a session TEMP table with its own index, mirroring the job's own already-proven vh_numeric_roll pattern -- not recomputed per page.
filesChanged: src/jobs/parcel-value-history.mjs -- HOIST_R_SITUS_SQL/INDEX/ANALYZE/DROP added; WILLIAMSON_HISTORY_CROSSWALK_SQL's target CTE now reads vh_r_situs WHERE situs_share_count = 1 instead of cad_property directly; runParcelValueHistory wires the hoist/drop into the Williamson county block alongside the existing numeric-roll hoist

src/jobs/vh-collision-remediate.mjs (NEW) -- ports S6's explicit reset-before-rerun discipline. Reuses S6's own EXPOSED_GROUPS_SQL unmodified (pure R-side situs-collision detection, no valueHistory content, no reason to duplicate). New logic (computeActuallyCollided): a (situs group, tax_year) is actually-collided when 2+ of the group's R-accounts each carry a viaCrosswalk=true companion row for that year -- simpler than S6's own per-field scalar case, since a valueHistory crosswalk row is one merged tuple written all at once (all four dollar fields from the identical numeric-roll row), never field-by-field, so there is no partial-collision case to distinguish.
src/control/writer-allowlist.mjs -- vh-collision-remediate registered (kind: remediate, mirroring s6-collision-remediate's own entry)
src/cli.mjs -- vh-collision-remediate dispatch case + usage string entry
